'''Ivers''' was<ref name="SWTOR" /> a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Great Houses of Alderaan|noble]] [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the war, Ivers held the rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. There Ivers sold weapon modifications to Republic individuals in exchange for [[commendation]]s, in the market section of House Organa's [[House Organa (estate)|estate]] in the [[Apalis Coast]] region. Ivers had fair skin, [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]], which included a strip of stubble on their chin. While working, Ivers wore [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Ivers appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Modification Commendations Vendor for Republic players on Alderaan.<ref name="SWTOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Ivers was removed from the game along with the rest of the Modification Commendations Vendors.<ref name="SWTOR" /> Ivers' position is also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a game guide released by [[Prima Games]].<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
